subunit: Binds NHERF1 and GPRASP1. Interacts with ARRB1 and ARRB2. Interacts with SRC. Interacts with USP20 and USP33. Interacts with VHL; the interaction, which is increased on hydroxylation of ADRB2, ubiquitinates ADRB2 leading to its degradation. Interacts with EGLN3; the interaction hydroxylates ADRB2 facilitating VHL-E3 ligase-mediated ubiquitination. Interacts (via PDZ-binding motif) with SNX27 (via PDZ domain); the interaction is required when endocytosed to prevent degradation in lysosomes and promote recycling to the plasma membrane. Interacts with CNIH4. Interacts with ARRDC3. Interacts with NEDD4. Interacts with MARCHF2
